# Michael Bender: PHP2Shell emergency response

> Michael Bender is a software founder who has built with PHP since 2004 and helps organizations respond to PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), the critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaws in PHP disclosed and patched on October 21, 2026. Available immediately. Phone: (919) 810-7503. Contact form: https://michaelbender.net/#contact

## Services
- Same-day exposure assessment and a go or no-go on taking sites offline
- Mitigation, patching to PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12, and source backports for PHP 7.4, 8.0, 8.1
- Compromise hunting, credential rotation, hardening and monitoring
- Upgrade or migration plans for legacy PHP 5.x to 8.1 (Laravel, WordPress, Drupal, Magento, custom)

## Key facts
- Affected: PHP installations serving web requests, including PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed. Highest risk on mod_php.
- PHP 8.1 and older receive no official releases; use vendor backports or the PHP team's minimal source backports.
- Temporary mitigations reduce specific attack paths but are not a fix.
